title: DC Lahore Proposes Dates for Basant 2027
excerpt: The Lahore deputy commissioner has submitted a summary to the Punjab government proposing dates for the 2027 Basant festival.
body_html:
The deputy commissioner of Lahore has officially submitted a summary to the Punjab government regarding the scheduling of the Basant festival.

According to the proposal, the event for Basant 2027 is suggested to take place starting in March. The final decision now rests with the provincial government following this submitted recommendation.
